team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Invite your team or your clients, decide what each person can do and see who did what.

rolesHelp.title: What each role can do
rolesHelp.owner: Everything, including plan, billing and transferring ownership. There is always at least one.
rolesHelp.admin: Invites and manages members, connects accounts, approves and schedules posts and sees activity.
rolesHelp.editor: Creates content and submits it for approval. Can't publish without an admin's sign-off.
rolesHelp.viewer: Read-only: sees projects, calendar and analytics.

projectAccess.title: Per-project access
projectAccess.body: Soon you'll be able to limit an editor or viewer to specific projects (ideal for agency clients). For now, every member sees all the workspace's projects according to their role.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.hint: They'll get a link valid for 7 days. They must accept it with a Kreo account using that same email.
invite.emailFailed: The invite for {email} was created, but we couldn't send the email. Copy the link and send it yourself:

members.title: {n, plural, =1 {1 member} other {# members}}
members.empty: No one else here yet. Invite your team to work together.
members.removeBody: {name} will lose access to this workspace immediately. Their content is kept.
members.transferBody: {name} will become an owner and you'll stay as admin. Only an owner can undo this.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.body: You'll lose access to {workspace} and its projects.
leave.last_member: You're the only member. If you no longer need it, you can delete your account from Settings.
leave.transfer_ownership_required: You're the only owner. Transfer ownership to another member before leaving.
leave.confirmBody: You'll need a new invite to come back.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.already_member: That person is already a member of the workspace.
errors.rate_limited: You've sent a lot of invites today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.plan_limit_members: You've reached your plan's member limit. Upgrade your plan to invite more people.
errors.last_owner: There must be at least one owner.
errors.last_member: You're the only member of the workspace.
errors.invalid_target: You can't do this to yourself.
errors.not_found: That member is no longer in the workspace.
errors.invitation_invalid: This invite isn't valid or has already been used.
errors.invitation_expired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invite is for a different email. Sign in with the invited email's account.
errors.mfa_required: Verify your second factor (2FA) to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

email.subject: You've been invited to {workspace} on Kreo
email.title: Join {workspace} on Kreo
email.body: {inviter} invited you to collaborate on “{workspace}” as {role}.
email.expires: The link expires in {days} days and only works with a Kreo account using this email.
email.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invite, ignore this email: nothing will be created.
email.footer: You're receiving this email because an administrator of a Kreo workspace invited you. This is not a marketing email.

approvals.title: Pending approval
approvals.introAdmin: Posts your team has submitted for approval. Open them to review and approve or send back to draft: nothing is published without your click.
approvals.introEditor: Posts submitted for approval. An admin will review them before they're scheduled.
approvals.emptyBody: No posts are waiting for approval.

activity.title: Activity
activity.onlyAdmins: Only admins and owners can see the activity log.

plans.pageSubtitle: Your plan sets the workspace limits. Credits are used to generate content with AI.
plans.freeIntro: You're on the free plan. Upgrade when you need more projects, accounts or members.
plans.pastDue: We couldn't charge the last invoice. Update your payment method to keep your plan.
plans.subscribed: Subscription active! Your plan and credits will update in a few seconds.
plans.onlyAdmins: Only admins and owners can change the plan.
plans.currentHint: Change plan or payment method, or cancel, from “Manage subscription”.
plans.freeCurrent: No card needed. Upgrade whenever you like.
plans.freeDowngrade: To go back to the free plan, cancel your subscription in “Manage subscription”. You'll keep your plan until the end of the paid period.
plans.changeInPortal: Switch to this plan from “Manage subscription” (prorated automatically).
plans.subscribeTerms: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and automatic monthly renewal. I can cancel anytime; the service starts now, so if I withdraw within 14 days I'll pay for the part used.
plans.vatNote: VAT included. Secure payment with Stripe. Invoice with every charge.
plans.provisional: Provisional prices and limits: they may change before launch.
plans.limitReached: You've reached your plan's {what} limit ({max}). Upgrade your plan to add more.
plans.limitNear: You're close to your {what} limit: {used} of {max}.

features.socialAccounts: {n, plural, =1 {1 social account} other {# social accounts}}

errors.not_configured: Subscriptions will be enabled as soon as we set up payments.
errors.forbidden: Only admins and owners can manage the plan.
errors.already_subscribed: You already have an active subscription. Change plan from “Manage subscription”.
errors.no_customer: There's no billing information for this workspace yet.
errors.generic: We couldn't open checkout. Please try again.

affiliates.title: Affiliates
affiliates.subtitle: Recommend Kreo and earn a recurring {pct} of what your referrals pay for {months} months.
affiliates.provisional: Provisional terms: the percentage and periods may change with 30 days' notice.
affiliates.suspended: Your affiliate account is suspended. Contact us if you think this is a mistake.
affiliates.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

join.title: Join the affiliate program
join.point1: Recurring {pct} commission on amounts collected (excl. VAT) for {months} months.
join.point2: {days}-day attribution: through your link (with cookie consent) or your code at sign-up.
join.point3: Dashboard with clicks, sign-ups, conversions and commissions. Aggregated data only: you'll never see who each referral is.
join.terms: I have read and accept the <link>affiliate program terms</link>, including the obligation to disclose advertising (#ad).

link.title: Your affiliate link
link.hint: Share it on your socials or with your audience. Sign-ups count for the next {days} days.

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.empty: No commissions yet. They'll show up here when a referral pays for a plan.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.manual: Payouts are manual for now: every month we review consolidated commissions (after a 30-day guarantee period) and pay them by bank transfer against your invoice.
payouts.future: Later we'll automate payouts with Stripe Connect or an affiliate platform.

disclosure.title: Always disclose that it's advertising
disclosure.body: When you promote Kreo, say clearly and up front that it's a paid partnership: “#ad”, “Advertising” or “Affiliate link”, and turn on each network's branded content label.
disclosure.noSpam: No spam, mass messaging or ads bidding on the “Kreo” brand.

claim.title: Did someone recommend Kreo to you?
claim.label: Affiliate code of the person who recommended Kreo
claim.done: Thanks! We've recorded who recommended you.

staff.title: Kreo team · pending commissions
staff.hint: Mark as paid only after making the transfer and receiving the affiliate's invoice. Respect the 30-day guarantee period.

errors.not_applied: Couldn't apply it: you already have a referrer, the period has passed or the code doesn't exist.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.not_configured: This feature isn't turned on yet.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

invite.title: Join {workspace}
invite.titleGeneric: You've been invited to a Kreo workspace
invite.signupHint: If you don't have an account yet, sign up with the invited email. Once you confirm your email, open this same link again to join.

invalid.title: Invalid invite
invalid.body: The link is wrong or no longer exists. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

accepted.title: Invite already accepted
accepted.body: This invite has already been used. If it was you, sign in to Kreo and pick the workspace from the menu.

revoked.title: Invite revoked
revoked.body: The person who invited you cancelled this invite.

expired.title: Invite expired
expired.body: Invites expire after 7 days. Ask for a new one.
